mapper.select: SELECT p.id, ai.lon, ai.lat, ps.location AS spaceName, s.name AS stationName FROM in_park_status p LEFT JOIN station_info s ON p.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN area_info ai ON s.area_id = ai.id AND ai.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN parking_space_info ps ON p.space_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT p.car_no AS plateNo, ai.lon, ai.lat, ps.location AS spaceName FROM in_park_status p LEFT JOIN station_info s ON p.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN area_info ai ON s.area_id = ai.id AND ai.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN parking_space_info ps ON p.space_id = ps.id AND ps.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.station_id = #{stationId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS inParkCarCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.over_time = '是' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overTimeCarCount FROM in_park_status p WHERE p.deleted = 0
AND p.station_id = #{stationId}
